items.evidence: README play command (work folder, --ticks 3 --settings fresh) prints one JSON object at screen title with every key the brief names (tick..records); no-season defaults as the brief says.
--frame X.png --size 800x480 after play runs wrote PNGs; header read 800 x 480 for all 12 frames taken (title, slots, settings, morning, stall, day x2, paused, evening x2, upgrades, season over).

Fresh place: texts Day Market/New season/Records/Stamps/Settings/Quit, menu_index 0; up at 0 stays 0, down x6 stops at 4; enter on Quit ended the run (later --at ticks all print the same title state, tick 10).

Settings opened with Language: English / Difficulty: Normal / Season: 7 days; left at English stayed, right -> es, right stayed; Hard/Easy limits held; 7<->3 limits held; Enter on Back and Escape both -> title.

After setting es/easy/3 in one run, a second run with the same --settings folder showed language es, difficulty easy, length 3; fresh folder: en/normal/7, slots [null,null,null], stamps [], records [].

Spanish runs over title, slots (both headings), settings, records, stamps, morning (order, Not enough coins), stall, day, paused, evening (order failed, stamps, Bankrupt/Season over), upgrades, season over: every text Spanish except Day Market; settings texts switch the same tick Language changes.
modules/work/strings/en.json and es.json (97 keys each, same keys); no English UI literals found in lib.rs; README 'A language:' paragraph says how to add one.
Fresh place, enter on New season: texts ['New season','Slot 1: Empty','Slot 2: Empty','Slot 3: Empty']; escape -> title.
Enter on slot 1: screen morning, day 1, slot 1, coins 50, reputation 50, all stock [], prices 4/6/11/14/7/9, upgrades [], crate_limit 8, order null, texts Morning, Day 1 of 7, Coins: 50.
Easy + 3 days: coins 60, 'Day 1 of 3', forecast of 3; Hard: coins 40; after changing settings to Hard/7 and Continue, season_difficulty easy and season_length 3 kept while difficulty hard, length 7.

Forecasts of 7 (or 3) entries from sun/cloud/rain/heat; weather = forecast[day-1] and Weather: text follows (day1 Rain, day2 Sun for seed 1); seed 1 twice gave identical forecast, seeds 2, 3 different.
12 season seeds: all wholesale prices within base-1..base+2 (apples 1-4, bread 2-5, cheese 5-8, fish 6-9, flowers 2-5, honey 5-7 seen); each row read exactly '<Good>: P a unit, stock N'.
Enter on Apples at 4: coins 50->26, stock [{units 6, days_left 5}]; second lot: coins 2, one batch of 12; row 'stock 12'; honey batch days_left null.
With 2 coins Enter on Bread changed nothing and added 'Not enough coins', gone after the next word; stock 93 apples -> buy -> 99; stock 99 -> buy changed neither coins nor stock.

Day 1 order null; day 2 orders over 12 seeds had units 4/6/8 and pay = units*ref*3/2 (e.g. 6 Bread for 54, 4 Fish for 84); accept -> taken true, 'Order taken: 6 Bread for 54'; second accept identical state.
After a Morning and pause->Title, a later run on the place showed 'Slot 1: Day 1 of 7, 50 coins' and title New season, Continue, Records, ...

Day-2 save continued with --seed 9: day, coins, reputation, stock, stall, prices, upgrades, forecast, wholesale, order, weather all equal to the unbroken run's day-2 Morning; Enter on empty slot 2 stayed on slots.

Escape on morning/stall/day -> Paused/Resume/Title; clock stayed 1 for 30 ticks paused; Escape and Enter on Resume returned with same screen, cursor, clock; Title -> title with slot 50 coins, no stock (the lot bought was not kept).
Stall opened with cursor (0,0), selected apples, texts Stall, Day 1 of 7, Good: Apples, Price: 4, Stock: 12, Crates: 0 of 8, Enter: open.
left/down at (0,0) no change; up -> y 1, up again stays; right x6 -> x 5 and stops.
next_good x6 cycled bread, cheese, fish, flowers, honey, apples; prev_good gave honey, flowers; Good/Price/Stock texts followed each time.
put at (0,0) -> stall gains apples, Crates: 1 of 8; put again unchanged; take removed, take on empty unchanged; 9th put with 8 crates unchanged (Crates: 8 of 8).
Apples price went 4..1, price_down at 1 unchanged; up to 12, price_up at 12 unchanged; Price text and prices followed.
Crates and apples price 5 set day 1 were in day 2's state and Stall texts, and in the Continue run's Morning (stall, prices equal).
Enter on Stall: screen day, clock 0, speed slow, texts 08:00 and Speed: Slow, taken/served/walked_out/passed 0, visitors list of 35.
12 seeds: ids 1..n, minutes strictly increasing in 0..479, types valid, wants distinct with counts 2/1/2/3; same seed+day -> identical list; 12 seeds -> 12 different lists.

--at every tick: slow clock +1 per 20 ticks, fast per 5, rush per tick, hold none (14 ticks, screen day); progress carried over (fast after 51 slow ticks reached minute 3 after 2 ticks); time and Speed texts followed.
finish 30 ticks into the day: evening, clock 480, coins 503, taken 379, served 28, walked_out 0, passed 6, same sales as rush run.
Same day at slow (9650 ticks), fast, rush, finish, and fast/hold/rush/slow mixed: identical screen, clock, coins, taken, served, walked_out, passed, reputation, sales, stock, texts.
Per-minute aisle compared to my own model of the brief over whole days (8 runs, 480 minutes each): 0 differences in aisle x, queue joined, tills.
Same per-minute comparison with back-row crates (sign off and on): baskets equal to the model at every minute, 0 differences.
Cook 10 arriving 66 at apples column 2 held 2 apples at 4 from clock 68, budget 32; apples at 5: no cook took (only 2 tourists, taken 10); at 6 tourists took 1 (taken 12); at 7 none (taken 0).
Model comparison enforcing budget and availability checks matched every minute, including contested stock runs where all goods sold out.
passed and queue (joined = arrival+6) matched the model at every minute in 8 full days.
tills ends, coins, taken, served, reputation and sales (with bargain tenth off) matched the model every minute; batches 6:1 + 30:5 with 29 sold left 7 units days 4 and spoiled 0 (oldest batch first).
Till/queue ordering within a minute matched the model's step order (1)-(6) at all 480 minutes in busy runs with queues.
Busy run with walk-outs (walked_out 1, 7) matched model each minute incl. reputation -2 and goods released; never a queued wait at patience.
At clock 480 screen evening; walked_out/passed equal to the model's at minute 479 (6 passed) with visitors left unpaid.
Second till slot: tills had 2 entries, both busy at once (frame and state), per-minute match with model filling till 1 first.
Sign run matched model where empty-basket visitors look at back row; results differ from no-sign run.
Taken order with 8 bread in stock: coins +54, 6 units gone, 'Order delivered: 54'; with no stock: reputation 50->45, 'Order failed'; not taken: nothing, no line.
Bread bought day 1 spoiled that evening (spoiled 6, 'Bread: ... spoiled 6'); fish bought day 1 days_left 1, spoiled day 2 evening; honey kept, days_left null.
Heat day without Cool box: apples 5->3, cheese 3->1, fish/flowers 2 spoiled; with Cool box: 4, 2, 1, 1.
Rent: 20 at Normal no crates, 'Rent: 21' Easy 3 crates, 'Rent: 36' Hard 3 crates, coins reduced accordingly.
Evening texts: Evening, Day N of 7, Taken/Served/Walked out/Passed equal to state, six good lines matching sales and stock, Rent, Coins, Reputation, Tomorrow: Sun (forecast next day).
Enter on Evening -> Upgrades, Coins: 178, Next day, Second till: 80, Cool box: 40, Sign: 30, Extra crates: 50, Awning: 35; Enter on Next day -> Morning day 2.
Extra crates 130->80, row 'Extra crates: owned', again unchanged; Sign 80->50 'Sign: owned'; Second till at 50 coins: nothing + 'Not enough coins'; next Stall: crate_limit 12, 'Crates: 0 of 12'.
Hard, 10 coins, 3 crates: Coins: -26 and 'Bankrupt' on Evening, slots all null; Enter -> Season over 'Bankrupt', 'Score: 0'; records gained bankrupt true.
Day 3 of 3, coins 100 rep 70: Season over, Score: 150 (80+70), Days: 3, Best: 150; slot emptied; title without Continue afterwards.

5 kept records + a new 150: list became 200,150(easy),150(hard),150(new),100 and the 0 dropped; lines 'Score 200, 7 days, Normal', 'Score 0, 2 days, Hard, bankrupt', 'No records yet'; shown in later runs.
'Stamp: First coin' etc. on evening in stamp order; with Whole season already kept, finishing again showed no Stamp line; Stamps screen 'Whole season: yes', rest 'no', in a later run.
first_coin after a paid day; full_stall with 8 crates at opening; whole_season on 3-day season ended solvent.
Day selling all stock with crates earned sold_out; day with apples crate not sold out and a bread crate with 0 stock earned only first_coin.
Day 2 replayed after Continue (seed 9) with same inputs: coins, taken, served, walked_out, passed, sales, visitors, texts, stock, reputation, stamps all equal to the unbroken run.
Two runs (seed 1, same 15-word script) on two fresh identical places printed identical state lists; other seeds gave other forecasts, wholesale and visitor lists.
left on title, put on Morning, accept/finish/rush/hold on Stall, escape on Evening all left the state unchanged.

modules/work/data/game.txt holds goods, visitor types, hourly rates, weather W/odds, rain_awning, difficulties, upgrades, stamps; README 'Changing things' explains goods, visitor types, upgrades, stamps.
stall.png: 2x6 grid, 8 crates at state positions in 6 distinct colours, white cursor at (2,1), panel 'Good: Fish', 'Price: 15', 'Crates: 8 of 8'.

day.png/day2.png: crates, visitor on aisle cell 4 with basket dots, two tills with visitors, queue, types by colour/size (cook green large, tourist teal small, regular orange wide); time, speed, coins, taken, served, reputation texts.

Title, slots, settings, morning, upgrades, paused, season over frames show texts with '>' on chosen entry; but both Evening frames show only '{work.disp0}' in the main panel plus the last few lines (Reputation, Tomorrow, Stamp): Evening, day, Taken..Coins are not drawn (engine also warned 'nothing keeps work.disp0').
README gives how to play, where kept (FOLDER/settings.json keys), and the headless and frame commands; both ran as written (SOMEFOLDER replaced) and printed state / wrote an 800x480 frame.

defects: Several input words at the same tick: only one acts (1:down,1:down,1:down gives menu_index 1); the brief requires each to act in order. README admits it.
Quit at tick 9 reports tick 10 (one extra tick counted/run before the run ends).
State printed at tick 0 shows default settings/slots before the kept place is loaded (es/easy place reads en/normal at tick 0, es/easy from tick 1).
Day frame draws the aisle below the back row of the stall, i.e. beside the back row rather than in front of the front row.
Evening frame: main text panel shows the raw placeholder '{work.disp0}'.
game.txt comment says names are in assets/strings/<language>.json; the tables actually used are modules/work/strings/*.json (README is right).
